observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission with the casing open, revealing the internal gears and components. The unit is dusty and has visible wear, including rust and grime. A person's hand is holding a tool near the front input shaft.
Photo 1 shows the top and side of the same transmission, with various hoses, connectors, and mounting points visible. The casing is metallic and shows signs of use and exposure to elements.
The watermark 'NEMZ AUTOSPARTS IN...' is present on both photos, suggesting a seller or distributor name.
No visible branding or model markings are readable on the transmission in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Rogue and Altima gearbox', but no such markings are visible on the unit.
